## Description

Patient adds a caregiver (name, mobile) with scopes (appointments, medicines, lab results, messages) and expiry; invite "they must verify with OTP"; caregiver sees "Viewing as caregiver for {name}" and only scoped items; patient can revoke anytime. Guardian proxies for minors follow country rules (from registration guardian).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A caregiver can access only the granted scopes until expiry (authorisation tests per scope).
- [ ] **AC2.** Revocation takes effect within 1 minute.
- [ ] **AC3.** Caregiver banner is always visible; actions are audited as the caregiver acting for the patient.
- [ ] **AC4.** Minor/guardian proxy rules are configured per country after legal confirmation.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
